g.text: Phase 2: mixed-subset performance by pool size
All same-size mixed subsets averaged within seed | Mean +/- SD of 10 seeds
The plotted score averages subset metrics; it is not an extra ensemble's prediction.
All subsets are retained. Different sizes have different compositions; no test-best subset is selected.
